DAWIS CLGOO Dagupan City Dear CL,GOO Dawis: 'This has reference to your letter dated 16 May 2013 informing the undersigned that the financial institutions (banks) in Dagupan City are requesting concurrence from the Department as to the legality of the assumption of Vice-Mayor Belen Fernandez as Acting Mayor of Dagupan City. Per your letter and its attachment, Sangguniang Panlungsod Member Brian Lim, in his advisory to his citymates dated 14 May 2013, admitted that his father, Dagupan City Mayor Benjamin S. Lim suffered a stroke on 12 May 2013 and had been taken to a local hospital and then to a hospital in Manila for further treatment. In order not to disrupt public service, Vice-Mayor Belen T. Fernandez assumed as Acting Mayor of Dagupan City on 16 May 2013 pursuant to Section 46 of Republic Act No. 7160. Hence, your letter. In reply thereto, Section 46 (a)' of Republic Act No. 7160 provides that the vice- mayor shall automatically exercise the powers and perform the duties and functions of the local chief executive (LCE) concerned when the latter is temporarily incapacitated to perform the same. In fact, the city vice-mayor's temporary assumption thereto is one of his duties, functions and responsibilities mandatecP under Republic Act No. 7160. Let it be noted however that Section 46 (a) of Republic Act No. 7160 does not limit the grounds for temporary incapacity in the office of the local chief executive to those enumerated therein, such as leave of absence, travel abroad, and suspension from office. Powers, Duties and The city vice-mayor shall: Exercise the powers and perform the duties and functions of the city mayor in cases of temporary vacancy as provided for in Section 46, Book I Of this Code; and It's more fun in the Phil

Said provision uses the phrase "such as, but not limited to" which only implies other similar cases, such as physical illness suffered by the LCE, among others. Undoubtedly, the nature of the duties and responsibilities of a LCE call for a full• time occupant to discharge them, and we are of the view that one cannot fully attend to or concentrate on the exercise thereof unless he be physically present in the local government unit where he ought to be. Accordingly, the stroke suffered by the LCE is Ei physical illness which could physically prevent him from continuing with thé performance of his official functions, albeit only on a temporary basis until such time that such physical incapacity shall have cease to exist. In view of the foregoing, we find the assumption of Vice-Mayor Belen Fernandez as Acting Mayor of Dagupan City in order. However, such assumption shall last until such time that the physical incapacity on the part of Mayor Lim shall have cease to exist and will not go beyond the latter's term of office. Please be guided accordingly. L,s/17 Copy furnished: DIR. CORAZON P. GURAY Regional Director DILG-Region 1 Aguila Road, City of San Fernando HON. BELEN FERNANDEZ Acting Mayor, Dagupan City V truly yours, AUSTERE A. PANADERO Undersecreta
